text:
gina_releng: deploybot is spiking an outlier drain alert on canary (us-east-1) for the /batch-generate route. Autorevert is queued. thinking we should do a short safety-hold and pin prod route instead of a blanket rollback because dedicated pools may be affected. thoughts?

deploybot: ALERT: Canary outlier-drain count 27 (threshold 10). Autorevert in 120s. telemetry: https://telemetry.local/outlier/1746008

lee_oncall: oncall here. Are we seeing 5xxs or timeouts? Any evidence it's a network flake?

anika_eng: primarily client timeouts on backend workers during heavy batch fanout; no auth/500 errors. Root looks like a batching drain bug in PR #721 where load shedding miscalculates slot capacity under high concurrency.}

pradeep_sales: FYI a few enterprise customers run heavy batched requests. If prod is hit we should send CSM note.

gina_releng: my proposal: 1) apply a short manual hold (10m) to stop autorevert 2) pin the prod route to previous stable model as a containment 3) revert the batching change on canary and validate 4) lift hold. This avoids a broad rollback and isolates impact.

lee_oncall: agree with hold+pin. applying hold now. `deploybot override --thread 1746008888 --hold 600 --reason "investigate outlier drain on batching"`

deploybot: ACTION: Autorevert HOLD applied by lee_oncall for 600s. Manual rollback still allowed.

anika_eng: pin command ready if we need it: `rctrl pin-route --route /batch-generate --model redwood-generate-v3-stable --reason "protect prod during investigation"`

gina_releng: I'll prepare a short CSM blurb: "We detected elevated client timeouts in canary related to a batching heuristic. We are holding automated rollback and may pin the prod route to stable as a precaution. No prod impact observed at time of notice."

anika_eng: attempting revert on canary now: ```git revert --no-edit 721 && infra/deploy --env canary --tag v3.6.7-rollback-batch```

anika_eng: revert deployed at 1746008950. quick smoke: `smoke: ok; outlier drain count down to 3; median latency stable`

pradeep_sales: thanks — I've queued a CSM ping with the blurb and ETA: 30m monitoring.

lee_oncall: since canary looks healthy, do not pin prod. We'll keep the hold for short monitoring window then cancel.

gina_releng: promoted fixed canary build at 1746008986 and posted PR links in #release-notes.

lee_oncall: canceling hold now. `deploybot override --thread 1746008888 --hold-cancel`

deploybot: NOTICE: Autorevert HOLD canceled by lee_oncall. Normal autorevert policy restored.

anika_eng: filing follow-up ticket to add an integration test for high-concurrency batch-drain (ENG-ops-289) and a soft-gate in changelog for batching heuristics.

gina_releng: closing loop — release-note snippet and CSM ping done. If we see recurrence we'll open a short postmortem. :white_check_mark:
